name: bestax-mcp
description: Build Bulma v1 React apps with Bestax. Gives coding agents the component props, examples, CSS variables and Agent Skills for @allxsmith/bestax-bulma from an index that ships in the package, so it works offline and needs no API key.

tools.name: list_components
tools.description: List every component with a one-line purpose, grouped by category

tools.name: search_bestax
tools.description: Search components, props, examples, CSS variables and skills in one ranked list

tools.name: get_component
tools.description: Import, summary and props for a component, with optional examples, CSS variables, accessibility notes and related components

tools.name: get_props
tools.description: One prop table, including compound sub-parts like Navbar.Brand

tools.name: get_examples
tools.description: Working tsx examples from a component's docs page

tools.name: get_css_variables
tools.description: The --bulma-* custom properties a component reads, with Sass names and defaults

tools.name: get_helper_props
tools.description: Spacing, color, typography, flexbox and visibility props to use instead of inline styles

tools.name: lookup_bulma_classes
tools.description: The bestax component and props for a Bulma class string like button is-primary

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: A skill's instructions, or one of its reference documents

npm.description: Local stdio server from npm (requires Node.js 22 or later)

examples.title: Sign-up form
examples.description: Build a form from bestax form components
examples.prompt: Build a sign-up form with email, password and a terms checkbox using bestax-bulma, with validation messages.

examples.title: Convert Bulma classes
examples.description: Swap raw Bulma markup for bestax components
examples.prompt: Which bestax components and props replace <button class="button is-primary is-large">?

examples.title: Dark mode
examples.description: Theme an app with Bulma CSS variables
examples.prompt: Add dark mode and a custom primary color to my bestax-bulma app.
